notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one mana-producing land.
description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate a mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and the mana-producing land.
Repeat from step 2.
